blind.description: A stylised terracotta or clay furnace/bloomery with a tapered cylindrical body bound by three thick black iron hoops. The top has a wide circular chimney opening with soot stains around the rim. At the bottom front is a small arched tap hole with an extended pouring spout. The structure rests on a circular ring of rounded grey stone blocks. All surfaces are clean, solid, and continuous with no hovering elements, cracks, or unpainted voids.
blind.from_above: A set of concentric circular forms showing a dark interior void surrounded by a thick, soot-stained orange-brown rim, the outer stone foundation base, and a small U-shaped pouring spout extending towards the bottom edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 4.5 feet tall (roughly chest-to-shoulder height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 3.5 to 4 feet in diameter at the stone base.

notes: Somewhat stockier than the catalog ratio, but matches request for a fat round furnace
